verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM documents a REST API at api.capsulecrm.com with Bearer-token auth, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Having an API is not the same as publishing a machine-readable spec, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
